tools.name: get-my-meals
tools.title: Get My Meals
tools.description: Read the signed-in employee’s saved meal for a date, absence notice, target-week selection and planning window. Uses EAT and never submits or changes meals.

tools.name: get-meal-menu
tools.title: Get Meal Menu
tools.description: Read the server planning target menu, including administrator overrides, or regular current/next-week menus and compatibility. Optionally preview recent/popular next-week choices without changing anything.

tools.name: prepare-meal-plan
tools.title: Prepare Meal Plan
tools.description: After user confirmation, prepare a complete local weekly meal draft from verified menu IDs and open its review in Raycast. Does not submit meals; the employee must explicitly submit from the review screen.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

ai.instructions: Help employees read their own meals and prepare weekly meal drafts. Interpret dates in Africa/Dar_es_Salaam. Get saved state with get-my-meals and menu IDs and compatibility with get-meal-menu using week=target before preparing a draft. The planning target can differ from the regular next calendar week under an administrator override. Never invent IDs, meals, dietary facts, holidays or a collection status. Ask about unclear meal preferences and skipped days. prepare-meal-plan requires all five days and the exact expectedSavedAt from a fresh read, requires confirmation, and only prepares a LOCAL DRAFT. Always say that the employee must review and submit in Plan My Meals. Never claim a draft is submitted, ordered or canceled. Existing quick-fill means recent eligible choices, not a guaranteed previous week. Do not offer absence edits/withdrawals, consumption marking, charge reversals or arbitrary historical-week reuse. For a question about today, call get-my-meals without a date so the tool resolves the current EAT date. Do not guess the date from model knowledge. A closed selection window still permits preparing a local draft; explain that server submission must wait for an eligible window.

@ipf-os Did you submit my meals after preparing the draft?
